		kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_cochin_copper_plates TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_cochin_copper_plates }
	}
}

# Rebuild the traveller's list of works worth a journey: held by another
# library and not yet mastered; works his own library lacks go on the
# priority list. Scope: the traveller.

	clear_variable_list = kehillah_journey_offer_works
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_journey_offer_priority
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }

				NOT = { root.var:kehillah_own_library ?= this }

		}
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_journey_offer_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }

		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_journey_offer_works target = flag:work_samaritan_pentateuch }

			limit = { NOT = { var:kehillah_own_library ?= { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_samaritan_pentateuch } } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_journey_offer_priority target = flag:work_samaritan_pentateuch }
		}
	}
